title: Online Multiplayer Game Platform
description: A platform to play multiplayer games like chess or tic-tac-toe with friends. Created for my team's SENG 300 term project.

title: (Grand) Master Audio
description: An audio player which is controlled through chess. Created for the 2026 Calgary Lacks Hackathon.

title: Auto-GG
description: A program to automatically generate SELF applications for UofC clubs. Called auto-gg as it automatically does all the work Gavin Grubert was hired to do.

title: Impartial Prejudice
description: A script which currates a TikTok feed based on a given prompt. Runner up for the Hack The Bias 2026 hackathon.

title: South Saskatchewan River
description: A website which allows users to view information about the South Saskatchewan River, and more broadly, the South Saskatchewan River Basin.

title: Hotel Manager
description: Hotel management software designed to be used as an administrative tool for hotel companies. Created for my team's CPSC 231 term project.

title: Spirits of Steel: A New Dawn
description: An alt-history grand strategy game, and the sequel to Spirits of Steel. With 400+ playable countries, 8 maps based on history and popular alt history scenarios, and more.

title: Block Pusher
description: A Minecraft mod for a puzzle mini game where you push blocks around a level to get to an exit. Winner of the DESS 2024 Hackathon.

title: It's Die Not Dice
description: A game made for the GMTK 2022 game jam. You play as a dice robot, and traverse a space station using a number of different movement styles.

title: Fightbuild
description: A survival game where you crash land onto an archipelago and must fight an onslaught of zombie rabbits, potentially escaping in the process.

title: Robot Training Protocol
description: A platformer game where you must traverse a level multiple times, with blocks disapearing every lap.
